paragraphs.text: Ezer (EE-zur ) was Adam Carthalion ’s spellsquire , who was entrusted with the care of Adam’s infant son, Jared , at the Battle of Aster Fall .

Ezer was Adam Carthalion 's spellsquire. At the Battle of Aster Fall , Carthalion commanded Ezer to flee with his son Jared . Ezer brought Jared to Arathoxia , where House Scarlet would not accept them. Ezer and Jared lived there as beggars. He fell sick but was partially healed by the alabaster potion Jared gave him. He never told Jared the truth about Adam Carthalion’s past. Ezer was killed when Jared infiltrated Castle Melmereth to kill Ravidel . He taught Jared the destructive capability of magic, and Jared's spin-kick "Ezer's Wheel" is named after him.
Ezer was a bit of a historian, recording several tales about House Carthalion .
